issues.on_page: General Fund budget schedule: Property 532,625, Carline tax 144, Motor vehicle 38,156, Road tax 10,875, Wheel tax 12,929
issues.issue: the printed 'Property taxes' line includes motor vehicle, wheel, road and carline taxes. The p8 breakdown is 1,378 off the p4 General Fund amount 593,351, so it can't be split exactly and keeping the printed label is defensible. Still, about 62k of the 622,044 is not property tax.

issues.on_page: Highway allocation 182,319, Motor vehicle fees 13,037, Incentive 3,000, State equalization 20,664, Homestead exemption 38,459
issues.issue: the line includes homestead exemption (38,459) and motor vehicle fees, which have their own categories. The breakdown doesn't tie exactly (off by 1,376), so it isn't split. The review note is already present.
mixed line; dominant category used, and the review note names the mix

issues.on_page: Cemetery column p11; the statement's Culture and recreation 244,430 = Cemetery + Park + Pool + Library
issues.issue: the rules put cemetery under health/welfare, but the report's own statement counts it in culture and recreation. Defensible, since it follows the statement.

issues.on_page: Bond Fund 'Other local taxes' 3,016; the governmental funds statement p4 shows it under Intergovernmental
issues.issue: the category follows the printed label, but the statement classes the same money as intergovernmental (possibly state tax credits for the bond levy)

issues.extracted: Proprietary Funds (Water and Sewer Fund combined) budget schedule p10
issues.on_page: Proprietary statement p6 prints separate Water and Sewer columns
issues.issue: under the per-fund detail rule (cities/villages), a combined all-funds schedule is replaced by one line per fund column of the proprietary statement. Here the combined water+sewer budget schedule (detail[79]-[86]) was kept instead. This is a judgment call.
cost-type line given category 'utilities', which is also the function name; a cost-type category such as 'Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone)' would be clearer
